name: coopanion-connector-dsh
description: Bridge between the Coopanion desktop pet (cortico-world-fatfish) and DeepSeek Harness: one loopback WebSocket where DSH reports its turns, approvals and replies, and accepts the pet's words into the conversation that owns it. v0.2.20 stops words from landing in the wrong conversation: a say may name its target session, the Host re-checks that target against the live list on every say and refuses a stale one instead of quietly falling back to a guessed owner, acks carry the delivered session plus the full open list, refusals carry a machine-readable code, and ready plus every session open/dispose pushes the complete list so the pet never has to guess where it is speaking. v0.2.19 bounds conversation creation at 8s so the pet gets a readable reason instead of a bare 20s timeout, and logs creation failures to the Host log. v0.2.18 reports context usage in turn-end (used/size) for fatfish's auto-handover and swallows late socket errors (ECONNRESET/EPIPE/ECONNABORTED) so a peer reset during pet connect/reconnect no longer crashes the DSH Host (issue #17). v0.2.17 finds sessions already open on DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 by awaiting ApiSessionAgentController.resolveAgent (issue #13) and reports ask_user_question as question / question-end frames (PR #14). v0.2.16 ships the rebuilt dist/index.cjs: 0.2.14 fixed apply() dying on cordis' service guard in source only, so 0.2.14 and 0.2.15 packages failed to activate on load with 'cannot get property webServer without inject' and /coopanion/status 404 (issues #11 and #12). v0.2.15 stops the upgrade route from being re-claimed every 5s on a Host that stores route copies (issue #8). v0.2.14 lets the pet name the workspace a new conversation lands in (PR #9) and fixes apply() dying on cordis' service guard (issue #9). v0.2.9 fixed CSWSH (issue #6).
author: Pal AI Lab
